text_markup: A {term:delayed conditional ability} is a conditional ability maintained by a lingering effect (see {ref:sec_lingering_effects}). Unlike other lingering effects, some delayed conditional abilities are created without an explicitly stated duration.
text_plain: A delayed conditional ability is a conditional ability maintained by a lingering effect (see section 9.10). Unlike other lingering effects, some delayed conditional abilities are created without an explicitly stated duration.
